# Stickman MCP — Complete LLM & Developer Reference (v0.3.1)

> Deterministic local 2D stick-figure animation and multi-scene movie engine with an 18-tool stdio MCP server. Zero AI video API cost; byte-identical SVG, HTML, GIF, MP4, and transparent VP9 WebM exports on Node.js 20+.

- **Live site:** https://vallahrich.github.io/stickman-mcp/
- **Repository:** https://github.com/vallahrich/stickman-mcp
- **Release:** https://github.com/vallahrich/stickman-mcp/releases/tag/v0.3.1
- **Runtime catalog:** 106 deterministic actions, 55 geometric vector props/add-ons, 3 strict JSON contracts (`stickman.animation/v1`, `stickman.animation/v2`, `stickman.movie/v1`).

## What Stickman MCP Solves

AI coding and presentation assistants struggle to produce repeatable, lightweight technical explainer animations: generative video APIs are non-deterministic, slow, costly, and cannot guarantee legible diagrams or exact slide alignment. Stickman MCP solves this with a pure local 2D vector animation compiler and stdio MCP server:

- **100% local & deterministic:** Same JSON input and timestamp always produces identical SVG geometry at 30 fps. No model-weight calls, no external network dependencies, zero per-render API cost.
- **Declarative multi-actor & multi-scene authoring:** Agents write concise cue-synced beats (`stickman.animation/v2`) or multi-scene movies (`stickman.movie/v1`) with contextual backdrops (`war-room`, `datacenter`, `office`, `stage`), `auto-director` virtual camera, 2.5D `depth` planes, `spotlight: "auto"`, editorial `say`/`think`/`badge` callouts, and shared single-prop `handoffTo`.
- **Built-in self-critique loop:** `stickman_critique` scores every scene across 6 weighted perceptual axes (`Prop Integrity`, `Spatial Continuity`, `Staging & Eye-Trace`, `Pacing & Readability`, `Kinematic Appeal`, `Cinematography`) and emits annotated SVG/PNG contact sheets so an agent can iterate until `passed: true` (`overallScore >= 8.5`).
- **Embeddable everywhere:** Export compact self-contained HTML players, scriptless animated SVG, orthographic CAD blueprint SVG, GIF, parallel H.264 MP4, or alpha-channel transparent VP9 WebM overlays, or mount `<stickman-player controls scroll-scrub blueprint>` in web pages.

## Quick Install

### Option 1 — GitHub Release Tarball (No Build Needed)

```sh
npm install ./vallahrich-stickman-mcp-0.3.1.tgz
npx stickman discover
npx stickman-mcp --root ./stickman-output
```

### Option 2 — Build From Source (Node.js 20+)

```sh
git clone https://github.com/vallahrich/stickman-mcp.git
cd stickman-mcp
npm install
npm run build
node dist/cli.js discover --category presentation
node dist/mcp.js --root ./stickman-output
```

## Copy-Paste MCP Server Configuration

Always pass an explicit `--root` directory. All file-writing tools (`stickman_export`, `stickman_render_film`, `stickman_author_motion`) strictly confine writes to new relative paths inside `--root` and refuse overwrites, traversal, or symlinks.

### GitHub Copilot CLI

```sh
copilot mcp add stickman -- node "/path/to/stickman-mcp/dist/mcp.js" --root "/path/to/stickman-output"
```

### VS Code (`.mcp.json`)

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "stickman": {
      "type": "stdio",
      "command": "node",
      "args": [
        "/path/to/stickman-mcp/dist/mcp.js",
        "--root",
        "/path/to/stickman-output"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

### Claude Code

```sh
claude mcp add --transport stdio stickman -- node "/path/to/stickman-mcp/dist/mcp.js" --root "/path/to/stickman-output"
```

### OpenAI Codex CLI

```sh
codex mcp add stickman -- node "/path/to/stickman-mcp/dist/mcp.js" --root "/path/to/stickman-output"
```

## MCP Surface (18 Tools · 14 Resources · 3 Prompts)

### Tools (18)

| Tool | Group | Mode | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `stickman_discover` | Discovery & Schema | Read-only | Discover supported runtime actions with optional category, tag, prop, kind, travel, or search filters. |
| `stickman_describe` | Discovery & Schema | Read-only | Describe one action by bare name (e.g. 'idea') or versioned ID (e.g. 'idea@1.1.0'). |
| `stickman_schema` | Discovery & Schema | Read-only | Return the strict JSON Schema for stickman.animation/v1, stickman.animation/v2, or stickman.movie/v1. |
| `stickman_story` | Discovery & Schema | Read-only | List combined IT story recipes or fetch an executable multi-action animation plus synchronized host cues. |
| `stickman_validate` | Choreography & Movies | Read-only | Validate a v1, v2, or movie/v1 document and return path-specific diagnostics. |
| `stickman_compile` | Choreography & Movies | Read-only | Validate and compile a v1, v2, or movie/v1 document into a canonical deterministic program. |
| `stickman_choreograph` | Choreography & Movies | Read-only | Auto-choreograph single- or multi-actor v2 beats using semantic anchors, natural timing, auto-props, and cues. |
| `stickman_movie` | Choreography & Movies | Read-only | Compose a multi-scene stickman.movie/v1 program with backdrops, fade/wipe transitions, idle-tail trimming, and optional critique. |
| `stickman_storyboard` | Review & Critique | Read-only | Render a multi-panel storyboard contact sheet (default or CAD blueprint) with bounds, overlap, and seam lint plus optional PNG. |
| `stickman_critique` | Review & Critique | Read-only | Run 6-axis perceptual quality scoring plus annotated SVG/PNG contact sheet and human critique rubric. |
| `stickman_preview` | Preview & Export | Read-only | Render a single SVG frame, animated SVG, storyboard SVG, or self-contained HTML preview to stdout/tool output. |
| `stickman_export` | Preview & Export | Writes under `--root` | Export svg-frame, svg, html, storyboard-svg, gif, mp4, or transparent webm to a new relative file under --root. |
| `stickman_list_film_assets` | Continuous Films | Read-only | List mechanically qualified film motion IDs, kits, headwear, places, set props, overlay primitives, and join count. |
| `stickman_check_join` | Continuous Films | Read-only | Check film-scale hard-join continuity cost and suggested bridge length between two approved motions. |
| `stickman_compose_film` | Continuous Films | Read-only | Validate and compose a strict JSON film recipe with automatic pose-space bridges and continuity bounds. |
| `stickman_render_film` | Continuous Films | Writes under `--root` | Render a film recipe into silent MP4, poster PNG, VTT captions, and optional QA sheet in a new directory under --root. |
| `stickman_author_motion` | Motion Authoring | Writes under `--root` | Author a status=draft motion from reusable pose keys with anatomy/contact/continuity gates into a new outputDir under --root. |
| `stickman_preview_motion` | Motion Authoring | Read-only | Render a sampled PNG preview strip for a draft, candidate, or packaged motion into a new outputDir under --root. |

### Resources (14)

- `stickman://catalog` — Grouped catalog of all runtime actions, clip markers, and prop metadata.
- `stickman://schema/v1` — Strict JSON Schema for stickman.animation/v1 single-actor timelines.
- `stickman://schema/v2` — Strict JSON Schema for stickman.animation/v2 multi-actor choreography.
- `stickman://schema/movie-v1` — Strict JSON Schema for stickman.movie/v1 multi-scene movies.
- `stickman://anchors` — Semantic stage anchors and coordinate conventions for the 800x450 canvas.
- `stickman://props` — All geometric runtime prop definitions, attachment sockets, and action auto-mappings.
- `stickman://rubric/human-critique` — 6-axis weighted quality rubric, pass thresholds, and visual self-critique checklist.
- `ui://stickman/player` — Self-contained interactive MCP App vector player UI resource with blueprint toggle and critique pills.
- `stickman://templates/presentation-pitch` — Ready-to-compile v2 single-actor slide presentation pitch template.
- `stickman://templates/two-actor-dialogue` — Ready-to-compile v2 two-actor cue-synced conversation template.
- `stickman://templates/idea-reveal` — Ready-to-compile v2 think -> idea lightbulb -> reveal -> cheer template.
- `stickman://templates/sports-action` — Ready-to-compile v2 hurdle -> basketball-shot -> fist-pump template.
- `stickman://templates/incident-warroom-movie` — Ready-to-compose 3-scene stickman.movie/v1 incident war-room recovery template.
- `stickman://templates/two-actor-handoff` — Ready-to-choreograph 2-actor shared card handoff and elevated stairs template.

### Prompts (3)

- `choreograph-slide` — Step-by-step workflow to choreograph, storyboard-critique, and export a deterministic stickman slide animation.
- `two-actor-dialogue` — Step-by-step workflow to choreograph and verify a 2-actor cue-synced stickman conversation.
- `create-and-critique-movie` — Step-by-step workflow to compose a multi-scene movie, run Tier A + Tier B critique until >= 8.5/10, and export.

## Export Formats

| Format | Flag / Option | External Dependencies | Use Case |
|---|---|---|---|
| Single SVG frame | `svg-frame` | None | Posters, documentation diagrams, static slide illustrations |
| Animated SVG | `svg` | None | Scriptless looping vector animations (GitHub READMEs, docs) |
| Self-contained HTML | `html` | None | Interactive compact player (`< 220 KB`) with play/pause, seek, blueprint toggle |
| Storyboard SVG | `storyboard-svg` | None | Multi-panel contact sheet (default or CAD blueprint theme) |
| Animated GIF | `gif` | Optional `@resvg/resvg-js` + FFmpeg | Quick messaging, PR previews, legacy slide decks |
| H.264 MP4 | `mp4` | Optional `@resvg/resvg-js` + FFmpeg | High-clarity silent explainer videos (parallel worker rasterization) |
| Transparent VP9 WebM | `webm` + `transparent: true` | Optional `@resvg/resvg-js` + FFmpeg | Alpha-channel (`yuva420p`) compositing over slides or video editors |

## Runnable Example 1: `stickman.animation/v2` (Multi-Actor Choreography)

```json
{
  "version": "stickman.animation/v2",
  "canvas": {
    "width": 800,
    "height": 450,
    "fps": 30
  },
  "theme": {
    "accentColor": "#2563eb",
    "background": "#ffffff"
  },
  "actors": [
    {
      "id": "presenter",
      "label": "Lead Presenter",
      "x": "left",
      "facing": "right",
      "color": "#0f172a",
      "accessory": "tie",
      "accentColor": "#e11d48",
      "zIndex": 2,
      "actions": [
        {
          "action": "write-board",
          "emitCue": "boardWritten"
        },
        {
          "action": "fist-pump",
          "afterCue": "approved"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "colleague",
      "label": "Design Reviewer",
      "x": "right",
      "facing": "left",
      "color": "#334155",
      "accessory": "glasses",
      "zIndex": 1,
      "actions": [
        {
          "action": "surprised",
          "afterCue": "boardWritten",
          "emitCue": "reacted"
        },
        {
          "action": "thumbs-up",
          "afterCue": "reacted",
          "emitCue": "approved"
        },
        {
          "action": "fist-pump",
          "afterCue": "approved"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

## Deterministic Guarantees & Scope Boundaries

- **Pure function of input and time:** `sampleAnimation(program, timeMs, mode)` and `sampleMovie(movie, timeMs, mode)` are deterministic with zero hidden timers, zero randomness, and zero network requests.
- **Accessibility built in:** `reduced` and `static` playback modes keep actors onstage in a meaningful summary pose and honor `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.
- **Explicit non-goals:** Stickman MCP is not a photorealistic AI video generator, 3D rigged character renderer, general physics simulator, or speech/audio synthesizer. Use it when you want clean, lightweight, auditable 2D technical explainers, slide animations, and storyboarded workflows.
- **Licensing:** Original engine, authored key-pose specifications, and geometric vector props are MIT-licensed (`LICENSE`). Compact CMU-derived motion clips retain CMU non-resale dataset terms documented in `NOTICE` and `docs/rights.md`.
